The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: sad because you are alone.

notes: While 'waḥīd' can describe someone who is physically by themselves, it is most often used to describe the feeling of being lonely.
Use this word when you want to emphasize the internal emotional state of isolation, rather than just the state of being solitary.

senses.definition: Feeling sad because you are alone or lack company.

examples.text: أشعر بِأَنَّنِي وَحِيد فِي هَذِهِ المَدِينَة الكَبِيرَة.
examples.translation: I feel lonely in this big city.
examples.emotion: a soft, melancholic admission of feeling lost in a crowd

senses.definition: Being the only one of its kind; single or sole.

examples.text: هَذَا هُوَ الطَّرِيق الوَحِيد إِلَى القَرْيَة.
examples.translation: This is the only road to the village.
examples.emotion: matter-of-fact and informative, pointing out a simple truth
